narratives.text: SATO Engineering Nigeria Limited is currently constructing (at completion stage) a 2 Storey Multipurpose Building with Offices (Academic Building Complex) Block B and College of Plant Science and Crop Production (COLPLANT) Building Phase II for Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta.

SATO Engineering has completed the construction of Administrative building and Laboratory for McPherson University Ajebo Ogun State. This is a private University being developed by the Four Square Gospel Church. SATO Engineering has drilled and commissioned Solar powered Boreholes for the Federal Government, State Governments, Corporate Organizations and private individuals. Using our state of the art drilling equipment and efficient personnel.

SATO Engineering Nigeria Limited is currently constructing (at completion stage) a 2 Storey Multipurpose Building with Offices (Academic Building Complex) Block B and College of Plant Science and Crop Production (COLPLANT) Building Phase II for Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta.
SATO Engineering is also working on the construction of Earth Dam at Fiditi project by Ogun Osun River Basin Development Authority.

SATO ENGINEERING completes and handover the rehabilitation of Ogere Water Scheme in Ogun State Nigeria, a World Bank financed project. During the handing over ceremony, the Head Project implementation Unit of the Ogun State Water Corporation, Engr. Maku, commended the company for a job well done.

He was impressed that an indigenous company could deliver top quality world-class work at the scheme. He then adviced SATO ENGINEERING to keep up with the good works and appealed to the staff at the scheme to ensure efficient and effective running and maintenance of the scheme.
The scope of the works included:
• Rehabilitation of the intake structure, filters, aerators, sedimentation tanks and Buildings.
• Designing and construction of over-head tanks.
• Rehabilitation of Booster Station.
• Designing and developing of state of the art electro-mechanical systems.
• Construction of over-head tanks, clear water tanks, flocculation chamber and staff quarters.
• Laying of several kilometres of Ductile iron pipes.
• Construction of flood control system.
SATO ENGINEERING completes the Construction of Obstetrics Care Facility, Mowe, Ogun State.
SATO ENGINEERING OPENS NEW BRANCHES

SATO ENGINEERING has opened branches in Lagos, Ibadan, Oyo State and the Abuja branch to be commissioned by September. Next year another branch will be opened in Accra as part of the company’s expansion programme.
SATO ENGINEERING completes and handover the construction of 32 Nos. Solar Powered Boreholes in Ogun State

SATO ENGINEERING receives West Africa’s Dynamic and outstanding Engineering Company Award (2012) in recognition of its innovation excellent and outstanding engineering services to all sectors of the Nigerian economy and beyond by the West African Nobles and Top Entrepreneur Forum and Aspire West Africa.

SATO ENGINEERING complete works on the dredging of Ogungbade River in Ibadan. The project was embarked upon to eliminate flooding at the Ogungbade Community and the people the community have been experiencing a flood free environment since the completion of the job.
SATO ENGINEERING has been awarded a contract to design and develop an Housing Estate in Abeokuta the capital city of Ogun State, Nigeria. The project details are as follows:
• 30 units of 5-bedroom Duplex
• 30 units of 4-bedroom bungalow
• 30 units of 3-bedroom bungalow
• 90 units of 1-bedroom studio
• Fire Service Centre
• Central Sewage System
• Water Supply Scheme

SATO ENGINEERING has been awarded contract for the channelization of the Lower Awba Stream at the University of Ibadan. The project is to put an end to the perennial flooding along the axis of the Awba Stream from the source to the Dam. The scope involves establishing horizontal alignment and setting out as designed excavating trench using profile levels and making good the excavation to receive concrete. Reinforcement bars of different sizes are to be bent and placed in line with project working drawings and concrete works to form the shape specified for the Channelization works.
SATO ENGINEERING fulfils its corporate several responsibility obligation by constructing a mini water supply scheme (Bore Hole) for Oladerin Village along Kobape in Ogun State.
SATO ENGINEERING is helping to make the dream of affordable housing a reality in Ogun State by working with choice investors to provide 5-Blocks, 4 Nos of 4-Bedroom flats. Details coming soon.
Information will be posted as events unfold

Sato Engineering has been awarded contract for the construction of an earth dam at Fiditi Dam. This is a Federal Government Project being financed by the Ogun-Osun River Basin Development Authority to provide water for the Agriculture and other needs for Fiditi Community.

Sato Engineering receives the Best Erosion Control and Construction Engineering Company Awards 2012 by the Institute Government Research and Leadership Technology. This award was presented to Sato Engineering during the African Governance and Corporate Leadership Awards 2012 on the 25th August 2012, at the Nicon Luxury Hotel Abuja. The award was presented by Her Excellency Angela B. Colley lheme the Gambian High Commissioner /Ambassador.
